scope: Why native TCC v41 not executed and why completed D04/D05 scientific verification is not established

root_causes.cause: 11 registered initiatives exceed hard guard of >10. The guard is placed BEFORE per-initiative state filtering and before scheduling executable jobs in dispatch.scan(), receiver.once(), tcc_runner.HostHandlers.preflight().
root_causes.effect: GitHub control scanner fails; pinned Mac TCC host preflight returns BLOCKED; receiver could not transition new queued initiative to RUNNING. No signed receipt or proof can be created via that path.

root_causes.cause: Installer routes both launchd StandardOutPath and StandardErrorPath to /dev/null. It launches tcc_runner --once every 60 seconds. GitHub record has no claimed run or signed receipt.
root_causes.effect: Host error path leaves no durable root-cause event/exception; QUEUED is ambiguous between offline host, exception, missing credentials, stale checkout, and permission failure.

root_causes.cause: V41 TCC Gate P03_CAUSAL_GATE reads actual_engine_ok; no upstream TCC action writes that state key; its actions only pin sources, split S3 contracts, and evaluate self-authored bounded S4.
root_causes.effect: Even if the capacity gate is repaired and native TCC v41 control runs, it has no valid execution path to real EC+LLM+Oracle causal evidence. BLOCK_REAL_CAUSAL is expected and not a scientific resolution.

root_causes.cause: Original 10-fixture author generator uses v* for correct options, x1 for invalid options, positive/negative judgment text, asymmetric dependencies, oracle_constraints and authored candidate relationships.
root_causes.effect: Source-defined label cues contaminate S3. Prefix-selection gives the known gold by construction on public fixed fixtures; 10/10 fixture Oracle replay is integrity, not independent semantic competence. New decontaminated predictor-visible input must be frozen before matched predictions.

root_causes.cause: EC-native S3 selects exactly one next action whereas original S3 specifies all admissible candidates for M003 and M009. Original S3 structural signature is insufficient to identify S4 closure for M001/M007 and M003/M009. Synthetic S4 512-state boolean testing uses unverified placeholder hashes and is not native EC S4.
root_causes.effect: Generating more TCC specifications cannot substitute for a separately declared common subfunction and a closure-sufficient source-grounded real execution state; original frozen EC_NATIVE_SCOPE_INCOMPATIBLE must be preserved.

root_causes.cause: V42 is a 17-node source-input specification and acceptance criteria, not a generated/evaluated runnable experiment. Attempt to register the native V42 runner was blocked by platform safety enforcement.
root_causes.effect: No native V42 generator result or actual EC/LLM scorer receipt exists; do not claim execution and do not reroute around blocked action.

Enforce max 3 concurrent jobs, bounded paging and one-at-a-time CAS ownership. No blind 10->100 constant tweak.
